questions.question: After Alex received his new electronic limb, he was finally able to use ______ arms to embrace his family, bringing tears of joy to everyone present.

S + find/consider/feel/think + it + adj./N + to VR Many people consider it important to set goals for their personal and professional lives. with + N（憑藉） With years of experience, Linda became an expert in the field of environmental science. make use of（≒ take advantage of） Students should make use of the library's resources to enhance their research projects. It seems/appears that + S + V It seems that Ben will never finish his project on time, despite his hard work. that of / those of（代替前述名詞） The mortgage rate at this bank is lower than that of the other bank. enable + O + to VR This new software enables users to learn complex coding skills quickly. 非限定 which（指前面整句） AI tools can instantly carry out complex tasks, which enables people to work more efficiently. in a(n) + adj. + way Karen solved the complex problem in an unexpected way, which surprised everyone. to a(n) + adj. + degree/extent Sea temperatures have risen to an alarming degree because of global warming. 課本綜合翻譯練習（參考答案） Sarah couldn't imagine living abroad before, but she now is capable of adapting to new cultures. With years of experience, she considers it useful to make use of her international background to communicate with global clients. 註：SOURCE 中文提示為「她認為利用自己的國際背景……很有用處」，故填 considers it useful to make use of。 單選練習題（Q1～Q30）
